name: blender-ai-plugin
description: AI technical-art team for Blender: 95 skills, 29 tested bpy scripts and a design orchestrator agent that drive the official Blender MCP server to model, texture, light, render, validate and export game-ready assets (Unreal, Unity, Godot) in any art style. Use for any Blender modeling, look-dev, scene or export task.

interface.shortDescription: Drive Blender through the official Blender MCP with a full technical-art skill set
interface.longDescription: 95 Blender skills (modeling, sculpt/retopo, UVs, PBR materials, geometry nodes, lighting, camera, rendering, compositing, rigging, animation, simulation, LODs, collision, Unreal/Unity/Godot export) plus art-style, genre, world and mood direction. Ships 29 bpy scripts tested on Blender 5.2 LTS and runs them through the official Blender Lab MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Build a game-ready sci-fi crate for Unreal, 2k tris, with collision and LODs
Light and render my current Blender scene in a PS1 horror style
Audit my open .blend and validate every mesh in COL_Export before export
